universe: All scheduled 2021 CPI and Employment Situation/NFP releases from the existing frozen BLS manifest; no event may be omitted for source difficulty.

CPI.record: Consensus column from the latest issue strictly published before T0 that contains the target CPI release.

NFP.primary_family: The Baker Group weekly market report / Lunch with Lester
NFP.record: Est. column from the latest dated/printed-as-of issue strictly before T0 that contains the target Employment Situation release.

timestamp_rule: The issue/report publication or printed-as-of state must be strictly before frozen BLS T0. Date-only evidence is acceptable only when the entire identified edition is from an earlier calendar date than T0; same-day date-only evidence fails.
version_rule: Accept only issue-specific static documents with auditable edition identity; mutable historical calendar rows are excluded.
conflict_rule: Never average or substitute another provider. A conflict within the frozen source family is SOURCE_CONFLICT.
missing_rule: Missing fields remain null and make that event incomplete.
note: Thresholds and source rules are frozen before the 2021 source census. Failure to reach coverage closes this route as PARTIAL_SOURCE/COVERAGE_BLOCKED; thresholds may not be lowered afterward.
